newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong to host 1998 Air Freight Asia conference.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong to host 1998 Air Freight Asia conference.

text.p: Whether air cargo wholesalers are a threat to airlines will be one of the main themes of the 1998 Air Freight Asia conference, to be held in Hong Kong, the organiser said.

Other topics will include Hong Kong's economic future, 'To own or not to own a freighter fleet', 'Will customers really benefit from alliances?' and 'Is there too much talk about EDI or can the Internet do the job as well?', "Payload Asia" magazine added.
The conference, and an accompanying trade exhibition, will be held at the Marriott Hotel in Hong Kong from March 4-6, 1998. -Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
